hero_titulo_puente: We are the bridge between stakeholders
hero_puente_1: Insurers, governments, fintechs, international cooperation — we build together financial protection systems that reach those who need them most.
hero_puente_2: Our work starts from understanding real people: their risks, their contexts, their vulnerabilities. From there we design solutions that not only respond to a crisis, but strengthen resilience before it occurs.
hero_puente_3: Protecting the most vulnerable families cannot be achieved alone. It is achieved when the right stakeholders work together.
hero_subtitulo_migrantes: The first insurance designed for migrant communities in Argentina. No long-term residency requirement, in your language, via WhatsApp.
hero_subtitulo_agricultores: We use technology to help insurers, governments and institutions stand with the most vulnerable farmers — protecting the food they grow, the land they work, and the future they build for their families.

quienes_parrafo: EstaCubierto was born from a simple conviction: insurance exists to protect people, but for decades the system left out those who need it most. For over 10 years we have been working on inclusive insurance projects in Latin America, building alongside international organizations, local cooperatives and vulnerable communities the solutions that the traditional market never knew how to offer.
quienes_hito: We were the creators of the first insurance product for a migrant community in Latin America: Ayllu, designed for the Bolivian community residing in Argentina, with more than 800,000 members. A solution that demonstrated that inclusive insurance is not philanthropy — it is a viable and scalable business model.
problema_stat_1: people in LATAM without access to insurance
problema_stat_2: micro-entrepreneurs, informal workers and migrants on the continent
problema_stat_3: of vulnerable rural households with no coverage of any kind
problema_parrafo: Traditional insurance was designed for someone else. It is expensive, complex and distributed through channels that don't understand rural life, informal neighborhoods or the migrant experience. As a result, millions of families face climate shocks, crop losses and economic crises every year with no safety net. We have spent a decade changing that.
problema_frase: Traditional insurance was designed for other people. Expensive, complex, inaccessible.
solucion_intro: We don't believe insurance is a luxury product. We believe protection is a right. That's why we develop simple, affordable and fully digital coverage for three segments the traditional market always overlooked.
solucion_general_titulo: Protection for what matters every day.
solucion_general_desc: Accessible coverage against income loss, accidents, theft or unexpected events that can destabilize a family or small business. Weekly or monthly premiums that adapt to variable incomes.
solucion_general_items: Income loss | Personal accidents | Theft or merchandise loss | Basic health assistance
solucion_climatico_titulo: When climate strikes, your insurance responds.
solucion_climatico_desc: Parametric insurance that activates automatically upon verified climate events. No assessments, no forms, no waiting. The farmer receives compensation before the damage compounds.
solucion_climatico_items: Drought | Frost | Hail | Flood | Extreme wind
solucion_agricola_desc: Specific coverage for smallholder farmers protecting their crops, infrastructure and working capital. Available in the farmer's language: Spanish, Quechua or Aymara.
solucion_agricola_items: Crop loss | Crop damage | Seed and input loss | Productive infrastructure damage
whatsapp_func_7: Transfer to a human agent when needed
whatsapp_vent_2: Available in more than 50 languages including native languages.
perfil_agricultor_titulo: You work the land. You deserve it to protect you too.
perfil_agricultor_desc: If you have a plot of land, work in the fields or are part of an agricultural cooperative, we have climate and agricultural insurance designed exactly for your situation. No paperwork or visits required.
perfil_agricultor_btn: I want to protect my harvest
perfil_microempresario_titulo: Your business is your livelihood. Protect it.
perfil_microempresario_desc: If you run a neighborhood business, work independently or are an informal economy entrepreneur, one unexpected event can unbalance everything you've built. Our general insurance adapts to variable incomes and pays out when you need it most.
perfil_microempresario_btn: I want to protect my business
perfil_migrante_titulo: You came here to build. You have the right to be protected.
perfil_migrante_desc: Living in a new country means facing risks without your usual support network. We have 10 years of experience designing insurance for migrant communities in LATAM. Accessible, multilingual products with no long residency requirements.
whatsapp_intro: Our service channel works where our clients already are: WhatsApp. No additional apps, no offices, no bureaucracy.

impacto_stat_3_desc: monthly per policy, sustainable and fair
impacto_parrafo: In 10 years we learned that real impact is not only measured in policies issued. It is measured in families who sleep peacefully after a hailstorm, in farmers who didn't lose everything to a drought, in migrants who for the first time have a protection network in their new country. That's what we build.
impacto_ods_titulo: Aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals
impacto_piloto: We are currently developing a pilot that articulates parametric insurance with farmer cooperatives and carbon credit certification. A new dimension of impact that we will publish in this section.
impacto_stat_2: renewal rate — trust that renews itself
card_aliado_titulo: Reach the market that traditional channels don't.
card_aliado_cuerpo: We have spent 10 years building bridges between the formal insurance system and LATAM's most underserved segments. If you are an insurer, fintech, cooperative or climate data company, we have the technology, distribution and segment knowledge to build products together that actually work.
card_inversor_titulo: 10 years of track record. A model ready to scale.
card_inversor_cuerpo: The microinsurance market in LATAM is USD 610 million and growing at 3% annually. We have 10 years of experience, 16,000 active clients, 77% renewal rate, projects with IOM, IDB Lab, Ashoka and UNDP, and a B2B2C model that combines measurable social impact with financial sustainability. We are at exactly the right moment to scale with the right resources.
equipo_intro: We are a team with over 10 years of combined experience in inclusive insurance, technology for emerging markets, and rural finance. We work with international organizations, have won competitive incubators, and built the first insurance product for migrants in LATAM. What drives us is not insurance as an industry — it's the concrete impact on people's lives.
equipo_maximiliano_desc: Inclusive insurance expert. Over a decade designing products for vulnerable populations. Creator of the first insurance for informal workers and the first cross-border insurance for migrants between Argentina and Bolivia. Member of the Microinsurance Network and expert recognized by the ILO.
equipo_gonzalo_desc: Lawyer and insurance broker. +20 years in commercial law and insurance. Advisor to the National Insurance Superintendency. Member of the Microinsurance Network and the ILO International Microinsurance Program. Combines legal rigor with strategic vision of the inclusive market.
equipo_clemence_desc: International actuary. +15 years in general insurance and microinsurance. Has provided technical assistance in over 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Europe. Expert in actuarial sciences and product design.
equipo_gino_desc: Serial entrepreneur. Insurtech leader, merging marketing and technology to revolutionize insurance. Co-founder of LISA, Bella TWIN, and other successful companies. Leverages innovation to transform the insurance world.
equipo_iris_desc: Guatemalan consultant. +30 years in microfinance and financial inclusion. Has advised IDB, IFAD, and UN Women in over 12 countries. Author of technical publications for ECLAC and IFAD. Regional reference in financial inclusion.
equipo_alonso_cargo: Business and Alliances Director - Teus SPA
equipo_alonso_desc: Entrepreneur and Insurance Broker. Experienced in directing Grupo Activa and as General Manager of Prospect Insurance Brokers Chile. Driver of initiatives in renewable energy and alliances for inclusive insurance with the State-owned Companies System (SEP).
equipo_elide_desc: Master's in Business Management UAI. Extensive experience in logistics, operations, and production in pharmaceutical, retail, and valuables industries (Brinks, Prosegur). Director of APLOG and member of REDMAD, leading operational excellence.
equipo_claudia_cargo: Founder and Executive Director - IHRM Corredores de Seguros
equipo_claudia_desc: Leader with over 20 years in the sector. Founder of IHRM Corredores de Seguros, a firm with 9 years of experience in corporate risk management solutions and insurance brokerage. Holds international certifications such as CIC (Certified Insurance Counselor) and Franklin Covey 4Dx Gold Certification.
equipo_reconocimientos: Members of the Microinsurance Network · Projects with IOM, BID Lab, Ashoka and UNDP · Winners of RUS and BID ao CUBO (Brazil) incubators · Recognized at the Hola América Social Innovation Festival (Ashoka + IOM) · Part of the Finnovating ecosystem
